deficiencies.description: The text uses "where" to describe the situation or context in which the terminology is encountered ("where a surgeon can see just by holding or touching a tumor"). The rewrite uses "since", introducing an unsourced causal link that asserts the terminology is still heard because a surgeon can tell by holding or touching the tumour.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: And you'll hear this kind of terminology even now, where a surgeon can see just by holding or touching a tumor, whether or not it's movable or immovable.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: This terminology is still heard now, since a surgeon can tell just by holding or touching a tumour whether it is movable or immovable.

considerations.sourcePassage: So when somebody presents with a lump or a primary tumor, there will be a biopsy to look and to see whether or not the tumor cells are contained or whether or not they're invading into the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: Rendering 'somebody' as 'a patient' and 'there will be a biopsy to look and to see' as 'a biopsy is taken to see' are allowed stylistic changes.
